title: Suriya's 'Scene' Locks Diwali Release for November 6: A Cop Comedy and Nazriya's Tamil Return
excerpt: Jithu Madhavan's first Tamil film casts Suriya as Inbaraj, an unorthodox interrogator, with Nazriya Nazim back in Tamil cinema and Netflix holding streaming rights.
body:
• Suriya's action comedy Scene, directed by Jithu Madhavan, releases worldwide in theatres on November 6, 2026, for Diwali.
  • Suriya plays Inbaraj, a police officer with an unconventional interrogation style; Nazriya Nazim returns to Tamil cinema alongside him, and Naslen makes his Tamil debut.
  • The film is Jithu Madhavan's first Tamil directorial, produced by Suriya and Jyotika's Zhagaram Studios with 2D Entertainment; Netflix holds the streaming rights.
  • US viewers: the film opens theatrically November 6; the Netflix streaming date has not been announced.

Suriya's next theatrical release now has its date and its shape. Scene, an action comedy directed by Malayalam filmmaker Jithu Madhavan, opens worldwide on November 6, 2026, as a Diwali release, with Suriya playing a police officer whose methods unsettle everyone around him. The title and date were announced by the makers in September, and the film's first single has since started the promotional build-up, according to Filmfare's account of the announcement.

The cop at the centre

The title teaser introduces Suriya's character, Inbaraj, arriving at a crime scene and asking who killed whom — only to be told that finding out is his job. A jail warden warns prisoners to stay in their cells because Inbaraj is coming, and the character presents himself as a cop who has locked up some 900 criminals. The tone, as reported by NewKerala's report on the teaser, mixes the interrogation room with comedy rather than playing the role straight.

"The title and date were announced by the makers in September, and the film's first single has since started the promotional build-up, according to Filmfare's account of the announcement ."

A first for the director, a return for the co-star

Scene is Jithu Madhavan's first Tamil film as director, after establishing himself in Malayalam cinema, and composer Sushin Shyam's first Tamil score — Shyam has scored all of Jithu's features. Nazriya Nazim returns to Tamil cinema after more than a decade; her last Tamil feature was Thirumanam Enum Nikkah in 2014. Naslen, known to Malayalam audiences from Premalu, makes his Tamil debut. The supporting cast includes Anand Raj, Lal and social media personality Raj Priyan in his feature debut. Dravid Selvam wrote the Tamil dialogues, Vineeth Augustian is the cinematographer and Ajmal Sabu the editor.

https://x.com/sri50/status/2109847946267426865

Production and the road to November 6

The film, referred to as Suriya 47 during production, is produced by Suriya and Jyotika under Zhagaram Studios with 2D Entertainment. Shooting began in December 2025 and wrapped in July 2026 across Tamil Nadu and Kerala, and the film is now in post-production. Netflix has acquired the digital streaming rights and Sony Music the music rights, according to the Kerala release details published by Kerala TV; in Kerala the film is released by Sree Gokulam Movies with Dream Big Films as distribution partner. The first single, a playful number centred on Nazriya's character, was released ahead of the campaign's next phase.

For diaspora viewers

Scene arrives in the Diwali corridor a few weeks after Rajinikanth's Jailer 2, and Dhanush has already moved his own film out of a clash with both titles — a sign of how crowded the festive window is. For US audiences, November 6 is a theatrical date; plan on the usual major-chain Tamil release circuit, with streaming on Netflix to follow at a date not yet announced.
